name: Millennium class
notes: Specialty = extra-charge restaurants open to all guests, excl. bars and suite/AquaClass venues (Sushi on Five, Le Petit Chef, Tuscan Grille). Jogging track: Celebrity says every ship has one; Cruise Spotlight says no (official source used).

name: Solstice class
notes: Specialty: Sushi on Five, Fine Cut Steakhouse, Murano, Trattoria Rossa. Pickleball set per ship (2023 rollout named Solstice, Equinox, Eclipse only).

name: Edge class
notes: Specialty: Raw on 5, Le Grand Bistro, Eden Restaurant, Fine Cut Steakhouse, Le Petit Chef & Family, Rooftop Garden Grill, Magic Carpet, Dinner on the Edge. No basketball court; pickleball in Rooftop Garden (set per ship). Pools: 1 general, 1 adults-only Solarium, 1 Retreat.
